items.source: "environmentProperties" is the name given to the PropertySource that wraps the environment supplied to this configurer.
items.translation: "environmentProperties" 是用于包装提供给此配置器的 environment 的 PropertySource 的名称。

items.source: "localProperties" is the name given to the PropertySource for the set of merged properties supplied to this configurer.
items.translation: "localProperties" 是分配给此配置器提供的 合并属性 集的 PropertySource 的名称。

items.source: in favor of processProperties(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory, ConfigurablePropertyResolver)
items.translation: 支持使用 processProperties(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory, ConfigurablePropertyResolver)

items.source: Return the property sources that were actually applied during post-processing.
items.translation: 返回在 后处理 期间实际应用的属性源。

items.source: Any local properties (for example, those added via PropertiesLoaderSupport.setProperties(Properties), PropertiesLoaderSupport.setLocations(Resource...) et al.) are added as a single PropertySource. Search precedence of local properties is based on the value of the localOverride property, which is by default false meaning that local properties are to be searched last, after all environment property sources.
items.translation: 任何本地属性（例如，通过PropertiesLoaderSupport.setProperties(Properties)、PropertiesLoaderSupport.setLocations(Resource...)等方法添加的属性）均作为单个PropertySource添加。本地属性的搜索优先级取决于localOverride属性的值，该属性默认值为false，这意味着本地属性将在所有环境属性源之后进行搜索。

items.source: This class is designed as a general replacement for PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer. It is used by default to support the property-placeholder element in working against the spring-context-3.1 or higher XSD; whereas, spring-context versions <= 3.0 default to PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer to ensure backward compatibility. See the spring-context XSD documentation for complete details.
items.translation: 该类设计为 PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer 的通用替代方案。默认情况下，它用于支持针对 spring-context-3.1 或更高版本 XSD 的 property-placeholder 元素；而对于 <= 3.0 版本的 spring-context，则默认使用 PropertyPlaceholderConfigurer 以确保向后兼容性。有关完整详细信息，请参阅 spring-context XSD 文档。

items.source: PropertySources from the given Environment will be searched when replacing ${...} placeholders.
items.translation: 来自给定Environment的PropertySources将在替换${...}占位符时进行搜索。

items.source: If setPropertySources(PropertySources) is called, environment and local properties will be ignored. This method is designed to give the user fine-grained control over property sources, and once set, the configurer makes no assumptions about adding additional sources.
items.translation: 如果调用了setPropertySources(PropertySources)，将忽略环境和本地属性。此方法旨在让用户对属性源进行细粒度控制，一旦设置，配置器就不会再假设需要添加其他属性源。

items.source: See ConfigurableEnvironment and related javadocs for details on manipulating environment property sources.
items.translation: 有关操作环境属性源的详细信息，请参阅ConfigurableEnvironment及相关 Javadoc。

items.source: The default implementation creates a PropertySourcesPropertyResolver.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个PropertySourcesPropertyResolver。

items.source:
Setting this property indicates that environment property sources and
local properties should be ignored.
items.translation: 设置此属性表示应忽略环境属性源和本地属性。

items.source: Processing occurs by replacing ${...} placeholders in bean definitions by resolving each against this configurer's set of PropertySources, which includes: all environment property sources, if an Environment is present merged local properties, if any have been specified any property sources set by calling setPropertySources(PropertySources)
items.translation: 处理过程是通过用此配置器的一组PropertySources中的每个值替换 bean 定义中的${...}占位符来实现的，该组包括： 如果存在Environment环境，则包含所有环境属性源 如果合并了本地属性，且任何 已设置属性源 通过调用setPropertySources(PropertySources)设置的任何属性源

items.source: Create a ConfigurablePropertyResolver for the specified property sources.
items.translation: 为指定的属性源创建一个ConfigurablePropertyResolver接口。

items.source: Customize the set of PropertySources to be used by this configurer.
items.translation: 自定义此配置器使用的PropertySources集合。

items.source: Implemented for compatibility with PlaceholderConfigurerSupport.
items.translation: 为实现与 PlaceholderConfigurerSupport 的兼容性而实现。

items.source:
Visit each bean definition in the given bean factory and attempt to replace ${...} property
placeholders with values from the given properties.
items.translation: 遍历给定 Bean 工厂中的每个 Bean 定义，并尝试使用给定属性中的值替换 ${...} 属性占位符。

items.source: merged local properties, if any have been specified
items.translation: 合并本地属性，如果 任何 已 设置 属性数组
